patch_description: Keep direct-demand rewards as the dominant signal, but add a conservative interaction reward for selecting both links of a two-hop route. The reward is divided across possible intermediate nodes so a high-demand pair is not counted repeatedly as though every possible route were used. These wedge interactions also give the QUBO a routing-informed interaction graph, unlike the current purely linear model. Increasing the degree penalty modestly may help reduce the low valid-sample rate, while leaving degree penalties out of the returned terms.
